(-सं) 	 1. Knowledge. 	 2. Medita-tion. 	 3. A carriage-road. 	 4. A fence. Ind. 	 1. (In composition,) With, together with; being substituted for सम्. or सह. 	 2. Like, similar, as in “सधर्म” which means having similar duties. 	 3. Same, identical, as in “सोदर”; combined with nouns it forms adjectives and adverbs; as सकोपः angry, सकोपम् angrily; सगर्व्वः proud, सगर्व्वम् haughtily; सविनयः modest, well-behaved, सविनयम् respect-fully; ससम्भ्रमः flurried, ससम्भ्रमम् flurriedly, सानन्दः joyful, सानन्दम् joyfully, &c.  E. षो to go, &c., aff. ड ।

सं Ind. (In composition,) With, together with, &c.; being the optional form of writing सम् before a consonant: before consonants of the first five classes, the Anuswāra may be again changed to the nasal of the class to which the letter it preceds belongs, as सं for सम् and कल्प make सङ्कल्प, &c.: before the semi-vowels, the sibilants, and ह, it preferably remains unaltered; this practice however is very arbitrary in this respect and the change is expressed or not, in all manuscripts according to the pleasure of the writer.

सखीजन: सखीजन n. (-नं) A female friend or confidante.  E. सखी, जन a person.
सख्य: सख्य n. (-ख्यं) 	 1. Friendship. 	 2. Equality. 	 m. (-ख्यः) A friend.  E. सखि a friend, यत् aff. of the property or pleonasm.

सगर: सगर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Poisonous. 	 m. (-रः) A sovereign of Ayodhyā, the father of ASAMANJA by KEŚINĪ, and sixty-thousand sons by SUMATI: the latter being turned into a heap of ashes by the sage KAPILA. GARUDA instructed the king to perform their funer-al ceremonies with the waters of Gangā, to be brought from heaven for that purpose; this was finally accomplished by the devotion of BHAGĪRATHA, the great-grandson of ASAMANJA, who having led the river to the sea, denominated it Sāgara, in honour of his ancestor.  E. स for सह with गर poison; being born together with a poison given to his mother by the other wife of his father.

सगर्भ्य: सगर्भ्य m. (-र्भ्यः) A brother of whole blood, one by the same father and mother.  E. स for समान same, गर्भ embryo, यत् aff.
सगर्व: सगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) 	 1. Proud. 	 2. Flated.  E. स with, गर्व्व pride.
सगर्व्व: सगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) 	 1. Proud. 	 2. Flated.  E. स with, गर्व्व pride.
सगुण: सगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Having or endowed with properties, qualities, &c. 	 2. Worldly. 	 3. Having a string, (as a bow.)  E. स with, गुण a quality.

सङ्कटाक्ष: सङ्कटाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Winking, leering. 	 m. (-क्षः) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.)  E. सङ्कट contracted, अक्षि the eye.
सङ्कथा: सङ्कथा f. (-था) Conversation, discourse, talking together.  E. सम् toge-ther, कथा speech; also सङ्कथन, &c.
सङ्कर: सङ्कर m. (-रः) 	 1. Mixing, blending, confounding. 	 2. A mixed caste or race, one proceeding from the promiscuous intercourse of the four tribes in the first instance, and again from their commerce with the descendants of such a connection, or the indiscriminate cohabitation of those descendants amongst one another; most Hindus of the present age are of one of the many branches of this race, the highest of which is impure and inferior to the Sudra: under this term two kinds of men are included according to the Rāmāyana; the one denominated योनिसङ्कर, mixed or degraded by birth and the other आचारसङ्कर degraded by conduct. 3. The mixing together of two or more dependent figures of speech in the same passage. 	 4. Dust, sweepings. 	 5. The crackling of flame. 	 f. (-री) A new bride.  E. सम् before कॄ to scatter, or कृ to make, aff. अप्.

सङ्करीकृत: सङ्करीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Blended, mixed, confused. 	 2. Outcaste.  E. सङ्कर, and कृत made, च्वि augment.

सङ्कल: सङ्कल m. (-लः) 	 1. Collection, quantity. 	 2. Addition.  E. सम् together, कल् to number, aff. अच् ।

सङ्कल्पभव: सङ्कल्पभव m. (-वः) KĀMA.  E. सङ्कल्प will, भव born.

सङ्कल्पात्मक: सङ्कल्पात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Willing, resolving, referring to volition. E. सङ्कल्प, आत्मक one with.

सङ्काश: सङ्काश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 	 1. Like, similar, (in composition.) 	 2. Near. 	 m. (-शः) Appearance, presence.  E. सम् before काश् to shine, aff. अच् ।

सङ्कीर्ण: सङ्कीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Crowded, confused. 	 2. Miscellaneous. 	 3. Im-pure. 	 4. Mixed. 	 5. Of mixed and consequently impure origin or caste. 	 6. Contracted, narrow. 	 7. (-र्णं) 	 1. An enemy. 	 2. A difficulty.  E. सम् before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त ।

सङ्कीर्तन: सङ्कीर्त्तन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Celebrating, praising, honour, glorification. 	 2. Singing the praise of a deity.  E. सम् before कॄत् to praise, aff. युच् ।
सङ्कीर्त्तन: सङ्कीर्त्तन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Celebrating, praising, honour, glorification. 	 2. Singing the praise of a deity.  E. सम् before कॄत् to praise, aff. युच् ।
सङ्कीर्तित: सङ्कीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praise, renowned, celebrated.  E. सम् intensitive, कॄत् to praise, aff. क्त ।

सङ्कुचित: सङ्कुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Unblown, unopened. 	 2. Closed, shut. 	 3. Narrowed, contracted.  E. सम् before कुच् to contract, aff. क्त ।
सङ्कुल: सङ्कुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Crowded, confused, filled with so as to be im-pervious. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Inconsistent and contradictory speech. 	 2. War. 3. A crowd, a mob. 	 4. A flock, a flight.  E. सम् together, कुल् to accumulate, aff. क ।

Sign, gesture, gesticulation. 4. A short explanatory rule, (in gram.) 	 n. (-तं) Rendezvous. E. सङ्केत to appoint a time, &c., aff. अच्; or सम + कित-घञ् ।

सङ्क्रीडण: सङ्क्रीडण n. (-णं) Sporting, playing.  E. सम् before क्रीड् to play, ल्युट् aff.
सङ्क्रीडमाण: सङ्क्रीडमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Sporting, playing.  E. सम् before क्रीड् to play, शानच् aff.
सङ्क्रुद्ध: सङ्क्रुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Violent, enraged.  E. सम्, and क्रुद्ध angry.

सङ्क्षेपण: सङ्क्षेपण n. (-णं) 	 1. Abridgment, brevity. 	 2. Sending. 	 3. Throwing. 	 4. Taking away.  E. सम् before क्षिप् to throw or send, aff. ल्युट् ।
सङ्क्षोभ: सङ्क्षोभ m. (-भः) 	 1. Overturning, upsetting. 	 2. Shaking, trembling, agita-tion. 	 3. Pride, arrogance.  E. सम् before क्षुभ् to tremble, aff. घञ् ।
सङ्क्ष्णुवान: सङ्क्ष्णुवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Whetting, sharpening. 	 2. Inflaming, exci-ting.  E. सम् before क्ष्णु to sharpen, शानच् aff.

सङ्ख्यात: सङ्ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Numbered, counted, reckoned. 	 n. (-तं) A num-ber. 	 f. (-ता) A kind of riddle or enigma.  E. सम् before ख्या to tell, aff. क्त ।

समर्थक: समर्थक n. (-कं) Aloe-wood, (Amyris agallocha.)  E. समर्थ fit, (for perfume,) कन् added.
समर्थता: समर्थता f. (-ता) 	 1. Strength, power, prowess. 	 2. Ability, capability, adequacy. 	 3. Signification of terms.  E. तल् aff. of the abstract, added to समर्थ; also समर्थत्व n. (-त्वं) ।
समर्थन: समर्थन n. (-नं) 	 1. Deliberation, deciding on the propriety or impropriety of anything; also समर्थना. 	 2. Perseverance in an arduous under-taking, attempting difficulties or impossibilities. 	 3. Reconciling differences, allaying a dispute. 	 4. Objecting, objection. 	 5. Potency, efficacy.  E. सम् before अर्थ् to ask or request, aff. ल्युट् ।
समर्द्धक: समर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Granting a boon.  E. सम् before ऋध् to augment, aff. ण्वुल् ।
समर्पण: समर्पण n. (-णं) Delivering, consigning, presenting.  E. सम्, अर्पण delivering.
समर्पणीय: समर्पणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be delivered, presented, made over, &c. E. सम्, and अर्पणीय to be delivered; also समर्पयितव्य and समर्प्य ।
समर्पित: समर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delivered, made over, consigned.  E. सम्, and अर्पित delivered.
समर्पितवत्: समर्पितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Giving or making over, delivering.  E. सम्, अर्पितवत् delivering.
समर्याद: समर्य्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Near, proximate. 	 2. Bounded, limited. 	 3. Correct in conduct. 	 4. Respectful.  E. स for सह with, मर्य्यादा a limit.
समर्य्याद: समर्य्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Near, proximate. 	 2. Bounded, limited. 	 3. Correct in conduct. 	 4. Respectful.  E. स for सह with, मर्य्यादा a limit.
समल: समल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Dirty, muddy, filthy, foul, impure. 	 2. Sinful. 	 n. (-लं) Fæces, ordure.  E. स for सह with, मल dirt.
समवकार: समवकार m. (-रः) A sort of dramatic entertainment.  E. सम्, and अव before कृ to make, aff. घञ्; described, as that in which the chiefs are engaged in mutual conflict to contest.
समवतार: समवतार m. (-रः) 	 1. A descent into a river or sacred bathing place at a TIRTHA. 	 2. A descent.  E. सम् with, अव below, तृ to cross or pass over, aff. घञ् ।
समवनत: समवनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, bowed.  E. सम्, and अव before णम् to bow, aff. क्त ।
समवर्ण: समवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Of the same caste, colour, &c. 	 m. (-र्णः) Com-munity of caste, &c.  E. सम, and वर्ण caste.
समवर्तिन्: समवर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) YAMA, the ruler of Tartarus.  E. सम् all, equal, वृत् to be or to select, aff. णिनि ।
समवर्त्तिन्: समवर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) YAMA, the ruler of Tartarus.  E. सम् all, equal, वृत् to be or to select, aff. णिनि ।
समवश्यात: समवश्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone away, wasted, destroyed.  E. सम्, and अव before श्यै to go, क्त aff.
समवसर्ग्य: समवसर्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं) To be let go or let out.  E. सम्, and अव before सृज् to loose, ण्यत् aff.
समवस्था: समवस्था f. (-स्था) 	 1. State, condition. 	 2. Similar state or condition.
समवाप्ति: समवाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining, getting.  E. सम्, and अव before आप् to get, क्तिन् aff.
समवाय: समवाय m. (-यः) 	 1. Multitude, assemblage, collection, aggregate, quan-tity. 	 2. One of the categories or Padārthas of logic, intimate and constant relation, as of yarn and the cloth made of it. 	 3. Connec-tion of species in a genus, or parts of a whole.  E. सम् and अव before अय् to go, aff. घञ् ।
समवायसम्बन्ध: समवायसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Inseparable relation, as of properties with subs-tances, material with manufacture, species with genus.  E. समवाय, and सम्बन्ध connection.
समवायिकारण: समवायिकारण n. (-णं) Inseparable cause or relation, as of material with produce, &c.  E. समवायिन्, and कारण cause.
समवायिन्: समवायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 	 1. Multitudinous, aggregated. 	 2. Connect-ed intimately. 	 n. (-यि) Intimate and inseparable cause, as earth of pottery, thread of cloth, &c.  E. समवाय, and इनि aff.
समवृत्ति: समवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Moderate, equable.  E. सम and वृत्ति practice.
समवेत: समवेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Mixed, mingled, blended. 	 2. Collected, assem-bled. 	 3. Connected with, related to, as properties with things. 4. Comprised in one genus.  E. सम् and अव before इण् to go, क्त aff.
समवेध: समवेध m. (-धः) Mean depth.  E. सम and वेध perforation.
समश्रुवान: समश्रुवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Spreading over, pervading, extending through-out.  E. सम् intensitive, अश् to pervade, शानच् aff.
समष्टि: समष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A collective aggregate, an aggregate which is viewed as constituted of parts of which each is consubstantially the same with the whole.  E. सम + अश्-व्याप्तौ क्तिन् ।
समष्ठिला: समष्ठिला f. (-ला) A sort of potherb, said to grow in watery places; according to some authorities, a kind of cucumber, to others a shrub, called commonly गांडरदूवी.  E. सम् together, स्था to stay, इतच् aff., deriv. irr.; or सम with, अस्थि a bone, (a seed,) ला to get or have, aff. क; also समष्ठीला ।
समसन: समसन n. (-नं) 	 1. Contracting, contraction. 	 2. Combination, conjunction, formation of compound terms.  E. सम् together, अस् to throw or direct, aff. ल्युट् ।
समसन्धि: समसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) Alliance or peace on equal terms.  E. सम, सन्धि union.
समसन्धित: समसन्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Allied on equal terms. 	 2. Bound or connec-ted equally.  E. सम, and सन्धित bound.
समसुप्ति: समसुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) The end of the Kalpa, and destruction of the universe.  E. सम universal, सुप्ति sleep.
समस्त: समस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. All, whole, entire, complete. 	 2. Compound, compounded. 	 3. Abridged, contracted. 	 m. (-स्तः) A whole, the aggre-gate of all the parts.  E. सम् together, अस् to throw or direct, aff. क्त ।
समस्थ: समस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 	 1. Even, equal, level, uniform. 	 2. Like, simi-lar.  E. सम even, स्थ what abides.
समस्थल: समस्थल nf. (-लं-ली) Level ground. 	 f. (-ली) The Doab, the country between the Ganges and Jamunā rivers.  E. सम level, स्थल soil.
समस्थलीकृत: समस्थलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Levelled, made level, filled up, (as a marsh or river.)  E. समस्थल and कृत made, च्वि aff.
समस्य: समस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 	 1. To be collected together. 	 2. To be made entire or complete. 	 f. (-स्या) Part of a stanza, proposed as a trial of skill to be completed.  E. सम even or complete, क्यच् affix, and सुक् augment; or सम together, अस् to direct, क्यप् or ण्यत् aff.
समस्थार्था: समस्थार्था f. (-र्था) Part of a stanza to be completed as a trial of skill. E. समस्य to be completed, अर्थ meaning.
समांश: समांश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Entitled to an equal share. 	 m. (-शः) An equal portion, a part.  E. सम, अंश part.
समांशहारिन्: समांशहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Sharing equally, a co-heir.  E. समांश, हारिन् who takes.
समांशिन्: समांशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) A co heir entitled to an equal share.  E. सम same, अंश part or portion, and इनि aff.
समांसमीना: समांसमीना f. (-ना) A cow bearing a calf every year.  E. समा year, in the second case, repeated, and ख aff.
समा: समा f. (-मा) Year; (according to AMARA'S lexicon this word is always used in the plural: PĀNINI however, uses it in the singular.) Ind. With, together with.  E. सम + अच्--टाप् ।
समाकर्षिन्: समाकर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) Possessing a diffusive fragrance. 	 m. (-र्षी) A scent spreading afar.  E. सम, and आङ् before कृष् to draw, aff. णिनि ।
समाकुल: समाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Agitated, bewildered, confused. 	 2. Crowded, thronged.  E. सम्, and आङ् before कुल् to accumulate, क aff.
समाकुलत्व: समाकुलत्व n. (-त्वं) Agitation, anxiety.  E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, समाकुलता ।
समाक्रान्त: समाक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Pervaded, spread. 	 2. Overcome, surpass-ed.  E. सम, and आङ् before क्रम् to go, aff. क्त ।
समाख्या: समाख्या f. (-ख्या) 	 1. Fame, reputation. 	 2. Appellation.  E. सम् all, आङ् before ख्या to tell or declare, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
समाख्यात: समाख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Famed, celebrated. 	 2. Notorious, public. 	 3. Reckoned up. 	 4. Declared.  E. सम्, and आङ् before ख्या to say, क्त aff.
समागत: समागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Arrived, approached. 	 2. Met, encountered. 3. United, joined.  E. सम् together, and आगत come.
समागति: समागति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Arrival, approach. 	 2. Union, joining. 	 3. Encounter-ing, meeting. 	 4. Similar condition or progress.  E. सम् with, or सम् same, आङ् before गम् to go, aff. क्तिन् ।
समागम: समागम m. (-मः) 	 1. Union, junction. 	 2. Arrival, approach. 	 3. Associa-tion, acquaintance, intercourse. 	 4. Encountering, meeting. 	 5. (In astronomy,) The occultation of a star.  E. सम् with, आगम coming.
समाघात: समाघात m. (-तः) 	 1. War, battle. 	 2. Striking, beating, killing.  E. सम् together, आघात striking.
समाचर: समाचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what observes, practices, proceeds, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before चर् to go, ट aff.
समाचरण: समाचरण n. (-णं) Following, practising, observing, proceeding.  E. सम् and आङ् before चर् to go, ल्युट् aff.
समाचरत्: समाचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Following, practising, behaving, proceeding, &c.  E. सम्, and आङ् before चर् to go, शतृ aff.
समाचार: समाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Equal or like in virtuous conduct. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Proper practice or conduct. 	 2. Proceeding, going. 	 3. Information, tradition, news.  E. सम्, and आङ् before चर् to go, घञ् aff.
समाच्छन्न: समाच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Covered with, involved in.  E. सम्, आच्छन्न covered.
समाज: समाज m. (-जः) 	 1. A multitude, a number, (of anything except beasts.) 2. An assembly, a meeting. 	 3. A convivial meeting, a club. 	 4. An elephant.  E. सम् like, and अज् to go, aff. घञ् ।
समाजिक: समाजिक m. (-कः) A member of an assembly, a spectator: also सामाजिक ।
समाज्ञा: समाज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Fame, reputation.  E. सम् all, आङ् before ज्ञा to know, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
समादान: समादान n. (-नं) 	 1. Receiving suitable donations. 	 2. Taking. 	 3. The daily observances of the Jaina sect.  E. सम् with, आदान taking.
समादाय: समादाय Ind. 	 1. Having taken. 	 2. Having accepted.  E. सम्, and आङ् before दा to give, ल्यप् aff.
समादिष्ट: समादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Enjoined, commanded.  E. सम्, आदिष्ट enjoined.
समादेय: समादेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Acceptable, to be selected or taken.  E. सम्, and आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.
समादेश: समादेश m. (-शः) Advice, direction, command, order.
समाधा: समाधा f. (-धा) 	 1. The act of collecting or composing. 	 2. Restraining the senses and fixing the mind in abstract contemplation on the true nature of spirit. 	 3. Profound absorption. 	 4. Contentment. 	 5. Answering an objection, replying to the Purva Paksha, (in logic.) 6. Agreeing, promising. 	 7. A leading incident which unexpectedly gives rise to the whole plot; also समाधान.  E. सम + आ + धा-अङ् ।
समाधान: समाधान n. (-नं) 	 1. Religious meditation, restraining the mind from external objects, and fixing it in profound absorption. 	 2. Promising, declaring. 	 3. (In the drama,) The leading incident, that which gives rise sometimes unexpectedly to the whole plot.  E. सम् in-tensitive, आङ् before धा to have or hold, aff. ल्युट्ः see the last.
समाधाय: समाधाय Ind. Having fixed upon, (the mind,) being intent upon.  E. सम्, and आङ् before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
समाधि: समाधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. Deep and devout meditation, restraining the senses and confining the mind to contemplation on the true nature of spirit, &c. 	 2. A religious vow or obligation. 	 3. Silence. 	 4. Promise, assent, engagement. 	 5. Composing or reconciling differences, put-ting a stop to a dispute. 	 6. Requital, return, retaliation. 	 7. At-tempting impossibilities; exertion or perseverance in extreme difficulties. 	 8. Storing corn on account of a dearth. 	 9. A Jaina saint of a future age. 	 10. A figure of rhetoric; connection or proximity of two events accidentally connected, and expressed by a common verb and the government of the verb by a double nominative, as उत्कण्ठिता च कुलटा जगामास्तञ्च भानुमान् the disloyal woman went sorrowfully, and the sun (went) down. 	 11. Collection, combination. 	 12. Demonstrated conclusion. 	 13. The joint of the neck. 	 14. A tomb, a grave.  E. सम् together, धा to have or hold, with आङ् prefix, and कि aff.
समाधिमत्: समाधिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 	 1. Contemplative, engaged in meditation. 2. Making a promise, announcing assent or permission.  E. समाधि, and मतुप् aff.
समाधिस्थ: समाधिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Devoted to meditation.  E. समाधि and स्थ who is.
समाध्मात: समाध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blown or puffed up, inflated.  E. सम् and आङ् before ध्मा to blow, क्त aff.
समान: समान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Like, similar. 	 2. Good, virtuous. 	 3. One, uniform, same. 	 4. Honoured. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. One of the five vital airs, that which is considered essential to digestion and occupies the cavity of the navel. 	 2. A corresponding letter of the alphabet, as a long vowel to its short one, &c. 	 3. A friend.  E. सम all, अन् to breathe, aff. अण् or घञ्; or सम् and आङ् before णी to get, aff. अच् ।
समानकालीन: समानकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Occurring or produced at the same period. E. समान same, काल time, ख aff.
समानगोत्र: समानगोत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Of the same lineage or family: see सगोत्र.  E. समान, गोत्र family.
समानजन्मन्: समानजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Of equal age.  E. समान, and जन्मन् birth.
समानजाति: समानजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a common tribe, sort, &c.  E. समान, and जाति sort.
समानजातीय: समानजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of the same caste or species.  E. समान, जातीय of a caste.
समानता: समानता f. (-ता) 	 1. Sameness, equality, likeness. 	 2. Community of kind or quality.  E. समान, and तल् aff.; also with त्व aff., समानत्वं ।
समानयत्: समानयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Making equal or like to. 	 2. Leading, bringing.  E. समान used as a verb, or सम् and आङ् before णी to get, शतृ aff.
समानयन: समानयन n. (-नं) Bringing, conducting.  E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, ल्युट् aff.
समानयम: समानयम m. (-मः) The same pitch of voice.
समानाधिकरण: समानाधिकरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Common or generic property. 	 2. A predicament or condition including several things or persons. 	 3. Same location or predicament. 	 m. (-णः) A generic character. Adj. 	 1. Being in the same category or predicament, having a common substratum, (in phil.) 	 2. Being in the same case or same government, (in gram.) E. समान, and अधिकरण possession.
समानाधिकार: समानाधिकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Similar or equal duty, office, or government. 2. Generic character.  E. समान, अधिकार office.
समानित: समानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken, led, conducted.  E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, क्त aff.
समानीय: समानीय Ind. Having taken.  E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, ल्यप् aff.
समानोदक: समानोदक m. (-कः) A kinsman, one who when distinct from the Sapiṇḍa is next in order and succession, and is connected by oblations of water only, to the manes of common ancestors; this relationship extends to the fourteenth in descent, i. e. the seven first or Sapiṇḍas presenting water as well as the cakes, are also Samānodakas, whilst the seven next presenting water alone are Samānodakas only.  E. समान common, उदक water.
समानोदर्य: समानोदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A brother of whole blood.  E. समान same, उदर belly, यत् aff.
समानोदर्य्य: समानोदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A brother of whole blood.  E. समान same, उदर belly, यत् aff.
समान्त: समान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a year.  E. समा a year, and अन्त end.
समाप: समाप m. (-पः) Sacrificing, offering oblations to the gods.  E. सम् same, आप water; in which libations of water are made.
समापक: समापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Filling, completing, finishing. 	 2. Killing. E. सम् together, आप् to get, aff. ण्वुल् ।
समापन: समापन n. (-नं) Conclusion, completion, finish. 	 2. A section, a chapter, a division. 	 3. Killing, destroying. 	 4. Profound meditation. 	 5. Gain, acquisition.  E. सम् with, together with, आप् to obtain, aff. ल्युट् ।
समापन्न: समापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Finished, done, completed, concluded. 	 2. Got, gained, obtained. 	 3. Distressed, afflicted. 	 4. Killed. 	 5. Accom-plished, perfect, (in any branch of study.) 	 6. Come, occurred. E. सम् implying completion, &c., आङ् before पद् to go, aff. क्त ।

समीहित: समीहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Wished, desired. 	 2. Undertaken. 	 n. (-तं) Wish, desire.  E. सम् before ईह् to wish, क्त aff.
समुख: समुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Eloquent.  E. स with, and मुख a mouth.
समुचित: समुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fit, right, proper.  E. सम् intensitive, उचित proper.
समुच्चय: समुच्चय m. (-यः) 	 1. Assemblage, collection, either in thought or fact. 2. Conjunction of words or sentences, the power of the particle and, or also; but it implies the conjunction of different objects of one act or different acts with the same object, as ईश्वरं गुरुञ्च भजस्व worship GOD, and (or also) the Guru.  E. सम् and उद् before चि to collect, aff. अच् or णच् ।
समुच्चर: समुच्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what goes about or up traverses, ascends, flies, &c.  E. सम् and उद् before चर् to go, अच् aff.; also with घञ्, समुच्चार ।
समुच्चरत्: समुच्चरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत) Going up or about.  E. सम् and उद् before चर् to go, शतृ aff.
समुच्छेद: समुच्छेद m. (-दः) Destroying, destruction.  E. सम् and उद् before छिद् to cut, aff. घञ् ।
समुच्छ्रय: समुच्छ्रय m. (-यः) 	 1. Opposition, enmity. 	 2. Height, elevation.  E. सम्, and उद् up, above, and श्रिञ् to serve, aff. अच् or णच् ।
समुच्छ्राय: समुच्छ्राय m. (-यः) Height, elevation.  E. सम् and उद् before श्रि to serve, aff. णच्, and the vowel made long, or घञ् aff.
समुच्छ्रित: समुच्छ्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) High, elevated, lofty.  E. सम् and उद् before श्वि to serve, aff. क्त ।
समुच्छ्वसित: समुच्छ्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sighing. 	 n. (-तं) A sigh.  E. सम् and उद् before श्वस् to breathe, and क्त aff.
समुच्छ्वास: समुच्छ्वास m. (-सः) Heavy expiration, sighing.  E. सम् and उद् before श्वस् to breathe, घञ् aff.
समुञ्झित: समुञ्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Left, abandoned, quitted, resigned.  E. सम् inten-sitive, and उञ्झित left.
समुत्कर्ष: समुत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) 	 1. Setting one self up as being of high tribe. 	 2. Exaltation.
समुत्क्रम: समुत्क्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Rise, ascent, going up. 	 2. Transgressing proper bounds.  E. सम् and उद् up, क्रम going, घञ् aff.
समुत्क्रोश: समुत्क्रोश m. (-शः) A osprey.  E. सम् intensitive, and उद् before क्रुश् to cry, aff. अच् or घञ् ।
समुत्तरत्: समुत्तरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Crossing, passing over or beyond.  E. सम् and उद् before तृ to cross, शतृ aff.
समुत्तेजन: समुत्तेजन n. (-नं) Inflaming, inciting, irritating.  E. सम् and उद् before तिज् to be sharp, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
समुत्तेजित: समुत्तेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inflamed, incited, excited, irritated.  E. सम् and उद् before तिज् to be sharp, causal v., क्त aff.
समुत्थ: समुत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) 	 1. Rising, risen, getting or got up. 	 2. Born, produced. 	 3. Occasioned, occurring.  E. सम् intensitive, उद् up, स्था to stand, क aff., the स is changed to थ ।
समुत्थान: समुत्थान n. (-नं) 	 1. Performance of work, occupation, effort, industry. 	 2. Positive indication or symptom of disease. 	 3. Rising, getting up. 4. Common growth or increase, (as of size or wealth, &c.) 	 5. Healing a wound or sore, cure or recovery from any injury. 	 6. Occupation.  E. सम् intensitive, उद् up, स्था to stay or be, aff. ल्युट् ।
समुत्थित: समुत्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Risen, got up. 	 2. Increased. 	 3. Derived or obtained from. 	 4. Cured, healed.  E. सम् and उद् before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
समुत्पतन: समुत्पतन n. (-नं) 	 1. Going. 	 2. Ascending. 	 3. Making effort, energy, exertion.  E. सम् and उद् before पत् to go, ल्युट् aff.
समुत्पतित: समुत्पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone, gone up, ascended. 	 2. Exerted, vigorous.  E. सम् and उद् before पत् to go, क्त aff.
समुत्पत्ति: समुत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Origin, production, birth. 	 2. Occurrence, incidence. E. सम् and उद् before पद् to go, क्तिन् aff.
समुत्पन्न: समुत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Born, produced. 	 2. Occurring, taking place. E. सम् and उद् before पद् to go, क्त aff.
समुत्पाट: समुत्पाट m. (-टः) Detaching, separating from, tearing from, &c.  E. सम् and उद् before पट् to go, causal v., अच् aff.
समुत्पाटित: समुत्पाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Detached or severed from, torn from. &c. E. सम् and उद् before पट् to go, causal v., क्त aff.
समुत्पादन: समुत्पादन n. (-नं) 	 1. Producing, fabricating. 	 2. Effecting.  E. सम् and उद् before पद् to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
समुत्पादित: समुत्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Produced, effected.  E. सम् and उद् before पद् to go, causal v., क्त aff.
समुत्पिञ्ज: समुत्पिञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Excessively confused or confounded, bewildered, lost, overcome. 	 m. (-ञ्जः) An army in great disorder.  E. सम् and उद् before पिजि to hurt, aff. अच्; also समुत्पिञ्जल, and simply पिञ्ज, &c.
समुत्सर्ग: समुत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) 	 1. Leaving, abandoning. 	 2. Giving. 	 3. Evacuation of urine or fæces.  E. सम् and उद् before सृज् to abandon, aff. घञ् ।
समुत्सव: समुत्सव m. (-वः) Festivity.  E. सम्, and उत्सव festival.
समुत्सुक: समुत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sorrowful, regretting, missing or grieving for any one absent, &c.  E. सम् intensitive, उत्सुक sorrowful.
समुत्सेध: समुत्सेध m. (-धः) 	 1. Height, elevation. 	 2. Fatness, thickness.  E. सम् and उद् before षिध् to go, aff. घञ् ।
समुदक्त: समुदक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Drawn, raised, lifted or thrown up from a deep place.  E. सम् with, and उद् up, अञ्च् to go, aff. क्त ।
समुदय: समुदय m. (-यः) 	 1. Multitude, number, heap or quantity. 	 2. War, battle. 	 3. Assent, rise. 	 4. Rising, (as of the sun, &c.) 	 5. Effort, exertion, perseverance. 	 6. A day. 	 7. The rear of an army. 	 8. Revenue.  E. सम् and उद् before इण् to go, aff. अच् or णच्; also समुदाय ।
समुदागम: समुदागम m. (-मः) Knowledge.  E. सम् and उद् before आगम knowledge.
समुदाचार: समुदाचार m. (-रः) 	 1. Intention, purpose, design, motive. 	 2. Proper or right usage.  E. सम् with, उद and आङ् before चर् to go, aff. घञ् ।
समुदाय: समुदाय m. (-यः) 	 1. War, battle. 	 2. Multitude, quantity, number, heap. 3. Rise, ascent. 	 4. The rear or reserve of an army.  E. सम् and उद् up, इण् to go, aff. णच्; also समुदय ।
समुदाहरण: समुदाहरण n. (-णं) Declaring, uttering. 	 2. An illustration.  E. सम् and उद् before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
समुदाहृत: समुदाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Declared. 	 2. Illustrated.  E. सम् and उद् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
समुदित: समुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Risen, ascended. 	 2. Risen, (as the sun, &c.) 3. Produced, excited, occasioned. 	 5. Possessed of. 	 6. Aggregated, united.  E. सम्, and उदित risen; or सम and उद् before इण् to go, क्त aff.
समुदीरण: समुदीरण n. (-णं) Repeating, declaring, speaking, reciting.  E. सम् and उद् before इर् to say, and ल्युट् aff.
समुदीरित: समुदीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, spoken, declared, recited.  E. सम् and उद् before ईर् to say, क्त aff.
समुद्ग: समुद्ग mfn. (-द्गः-द्गा-द्गं) 	 1. Who or what rises or goes up. 	 2. Who or what pervades entirely. 	 3. Having a cover or lid. 	 4. Having beans. m. (-द्गः) 	 1. A casket, a covered box. 	 2. A stanza in which two or more of the PĀDAS correspond in sound, though in a different sense.  E. सम् and उद् before गम् to go, aff. ड ।
समुद्गक: समुद्गक m. (-कः) 	 1. A casket, a covered box. 	 2. A sort of stanza: one, each half of which consists of the very same words but in differ-ent acceptations, those of one half being respectively the attributives or adjectives to those of the other.  E. सम् and उद् before गम् to go, aff. ड and कन् added.
समुद्गम: समुद्गम m. (-मः) 	 1. Rising, ascent. 	 2. Birth, production. 	 3. Arising, issuing, coming out.  E. सम् and उद् before गम् to go, aff. अच् ।
समुद्गयमक: समुद्गयमक n. (-कं) (In rhetoric,) The repetition of the same words in diff-erent PĀDAS of a stanza, but in a different sense.  E. समुद्ग what goes completely, यमक alliteration.
समुद्गिरण: समुद्गिरण n. (-णं) 	 1. What is vomited or ejected. 	 2. Lifting up.
समुद्गीत: समुद्गीत n. (-तं) A loud song.  E. सम and उद् before गै to sing, क्त aff.
समुद्गीर्ण: समुद्गीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Brought up, (as food,) vomited. 	 2. Raised or lifted up, (from a depth, &c.) 	 3. Uttered, exclaimed raised, (as a cry, &c.)  E. सम् and उद् before गॄ to swallow, or sound, aff. क्त ।
समुद्दिष्ट: समुद्दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Pointed out, shewn. 	 2. Particularised, enumerated. 	 3. Explained.  E. सम् and उद् before दिश् to shew, क्त aff.
समुद्देश: समुद्देश m. (-शः) 	 1. Describing. 	 2. Pointing out. 	 3. Particularising, explaining, enumerating.  E. सम् and उद् before दिश् to shew, घञ् aff.
समुद्धत: समुद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Ill-mannered, behaving ill or improperly, conducting one's self discreditably. 	 2. Raised or drawn up. 	 3. Upheld, supported. 	 4. Arrogant, proud, puffed up with pride, &c. 5. Impudent.  E. सम् and उद् before हन् to hurt or kill, aff. क्त ।

समुद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Ill-behaved. 	 2. Thrown up, (as food, &c.) 	 3. Raised or drawn up. 	 4. Extricated, lifted out or from. 	 5. Taken as a share, set apart, divided. 	 6. Seized, possessed of.  E. सम् and उद् before धृ to have, or हृ to take, aff. क्त ।
समुद्धरण: समुद्धरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Food vomited or thrown up. 	 2. Drawing up, raising, lifting, (as water from a well, &c.) 	 3. Eradicating a tree, &c. pull-ing up by the roots. 	 4. Extricating, lifting out. 	 5. Taking out from, as a part or share.  E. सम् and उद् before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट् ।
समुद्धर्तृ: समुद्धर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Who or what lifts, raises, extricates, &c. 	 m. (-र्त्ता) A redeemer, a deliverer.  E. सम् and उद् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
समुद्धर्त्तृ: समुद्धर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Who or what lifts, raises, extricates, &c. 	 m. (-र्त्ता) A redeemer, a deliverer.  E. सम् and उद् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
समुद्धस्त: समुद्धस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Wiped off by the hand.  E. सम् and उद् before हस्त the hand.
समुद्भव: समुद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced. 	 m. (-वः) Production, origin. E. सम् and उद् before भव being.
समुद्भूत: समुद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Born, produced, derived.  E. सम् and उद् before भू to be, क्त aff.
समुद्यत: समुद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ready, prepared.  E. सम् intensitive, उद्यत active.
समुद्यम: समुद्यम m. (-मः) 	 1. Commencement, onset. 	 2. Effort, exertion. 	 3. Lifting up.  E. सम्, and उद्यम effort.
समुद्र: समुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Sealed, stamped. 	 m. (-द्रः) A sea, an ocean.  E. सम् before उन्दि to be wet, and रक् aff.; or स for सह with, and मुद्रा a seal; also thence signifying a limit, (i. e. bounded by conti-nents,) or a jewel, (the receptacle of gems,) or सम् with, उद्र an otter; or स with, मुद pleasure, or सम् together, उद water, and रा to give or have, aff. क, &c.
समुद्रकफ: समुद्रकफ m. (-फः) Cuttle-fish-bone.  E. समुद्र the sea, and कफ phlegm.
समुद्रकान्ता: समुद्रकान्ता f. (-न्ता) A river.  E. समुद्र the sea, and कान्ता the mistress.
समुद्रग: समुद्रग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Ocean-going, sea-faring. 	 m. (-गः) 	 1. A trader by sea. 	 2. A seaman. 	 f. (-गा) A river.  E. समुद्र the sea, ग who goes to.
समुद्रगृह: समुद्रगृह n. (-हं) A sort of pleasure or summer house, built in the midst of water, &c.  E. समुद्र the sea, and गृह house.
समुद्रचुलुक: समुद्रचुलुक m. (-कः) The saint AGASTYA.  E. समुद्र the sea, चुलुक a pot; having drank up the ocean.
समुद्रतट: समुद्रतट n. (-टं) The sea-coast.  E. समुद्र, and तट a bank.
समुद्रतीर: समुद्रतीर n. (-रं) The sea-shore.  E. समुद्र, and तीर a bank.
समुद्रदयिता: समुद्रदयिता f. (-ता) A river.  E. समुद्र the sea, and दयिता beloved.
समुद्रनवनीत: समुद्रनवनीत n. (-तं) 	 1. The beverage of immortality. 	 2. The moon. E. समुद्र the ocean, and नवनीत butter: being produced or recovered by the churning of the ocean.
समुद्रफेन: समुद्रफेन m. (-नः) Cuttle-fish-bone.  E. समुद्र the sea, फेन froth or foam.
समुद्रमेखला: समुद्रमेखला f. (-ला) The earth.  E. समुद्र the sea, मेखला a zone; the sea-girt; surrounded by the ocean as by a girdle.
समुद्रयान: समुद्रयान n. (-नं) 	 1. A sea-voyage. 	 2. A vessel, a ship.  E. समुद्र, यान going.
समुद्रयायिन्: समुद्रयायिन् m. (-यी) A sailor, a navigator, a merchant trading by sea. E. समुद्र, and यायिन् who goes.
समुद्ररसना: समुद्ररसना f. (-ना) The earth.  E. समुद्र the sea, and रसना a zone.
समुद्रलवण: समुद्रलवण n. (-णं) Sea-salt.  E. समुद्र the sea, and लवण salt.
समुद्रवह्नि: समुद्रवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) Submarine fire.  E. समुद्र the sea, and वह्नि fire.
समुद्रविजय: समुद्रविजय m. (-यः) The father of the Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present era.  E. समुद्र the sea. and विजय victor.
समुद्रवेला: समुद्रवेला f. (-ला) A wave of the sea.  E. समुद्र, and वेला a wave.
समुद्रान्त: समुद्रान्त n. (-न्तं) 	 1. The nutmeg. 	 2. The sea-shore. 	 f. (-न्ता) 	 1. A shrub, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 	 2. The cotton plant. 	 3. A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) 	 4. The earth.  E. समुद्र the sea, and अन्त end or boundary.
समुद्राम्बरा: समुद्राम्बरा f. (-रा) The earth.  E. समुद्र the sea, and अम्बर vesture; clothed or invested by the ocean.
समुद्रारु: समुद्रारु m. (-रुः) 	 1. A shark. 	 2. A large fabulous fish, perhaps inten-ding the whole, hyperbolically described. 	 3. RĀMA'S bridge. E. समुद्र the sea, ऋ to go, aff. उण् ।
समुद्रिय: समुद्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Marine, oceanic, maritime.  E. समुद्र the sea, aff. घ or छ; also समुद्रीय ।
समुद्वह: समुद्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Who or what lifts or bears up. 	 2. Moving up and down.  E. सम् and उद् before वह् to bear, अच् or घञ् aff.
समुद्वहत्: समुद्वहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 	 1. Lifting or raising up. 	 2. Moving up and down.  E. सम् and उद् before वह् to bear, शतृ aff.
समुन्दन: समुन्दन n. (-नं) Wetness, damp, moisture.  E. सम् before उन्दि to be moist or wet, aff. ल्युट् ।
समुन्न: समुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Wet, moist, moistened.  E. सम् before उन्द् to be wet, aff. क्त ।
समुन्नत: समुन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. High, lofty, elevated. 	 2. Full, prominent. 3. Exalted, dignified. 	 4. Proud, arrogant. 	 5. Lifted up, raised up. 6. Just, upright.  E. सम् and उद् before नम् to bow, aff. क्त ।
समुन्नति: समुन्नति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Height, elevation, (physical and mental.) 	 2. Conse-quence, rank, dignity, exaltation. 	 3. Pride, loftiness. 	 4. Lifting up. 5. Increase, thriving, prosperity.  E. सम् and उद् before नम् to bow, aff. क्तिन् ।
समुन्नद्ध: समुन्नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Conceited of learning, thinking one's self learned. 	 2. Proud, arrogant. 	 3. Produced, born. 	 4. Tied up or above. 	 5. Supreme, lord or master.  E. सम् and उद् before णह् to tie, aff. क्त ।
समुन्नय: समुन्नय m. (-यः) 	 1. Occurrence, event. 	 2. Gaining, attaining.  E. सम् and उद् before णी to take, अच् aff.
समुन्नयत्: समुन्नयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Attaining, gaining.  E. सम् and उद् before णी to get, शतृ aff.
समुपक्षित: समुपक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld.  E. सम् and उद् before ईक्ष् to see, क्त aff.

(-द्धः) 1. A divine personage of undefined attributes or character; a sort of demigod or spirit, inhabiting with the Vidyādharas, Munis, &c. in the middle air, or the region between the earth and sun. 	 2. A wooden shoe or slipper, especially one over which some mystical formulæ have been repeated, and which will then, it is supposed, convey the wearer every where safely and rapidly. 	 13. A medicinal root; also Riddhi. 	 14. Settlement, establishment. 	 15. Certainty, truth. 	 16. Decision, (of a law suit.) 	 17. The solution of a problem. 	 18. Pre-paration, cooking. 	 19. सीमान्त: सीमान्त m. (-न्तः) A frontier line, a border.

सुकर्म्मन्: सुकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 	 1. Virtuous, good, acting virtuously, doing what is right and fit. 	 2. Active, diligent. 	 m. (-र्म्मा) 	 1. The artist or architect of the gods. 	 2. One of the astronomical Yogas.  E. सु good, कर्म्मन् act, action.

सुखवर्चक: सुखवर्च्चक m. (-कः) Natron, alkali.  E. सुख pleasure, वर्च्च् to shine, aff. क्वुन् ।
सुखवर्च्चक: सुखवर्च्चक m. (-कः) Natron, alkali.  E. सुख pleasure, वर्च्च् to shine, aff. क्वुन् ।

सुखसाध्य: सुखसाध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 	 1. Easy of accomplishment or attainment. 2. Easy of cure. 	 3. Easy to be discomfited.  E. सुख, and साध्य to be broken.
सुखस्पर्श: सुखस्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Gratifying, agreeable to the touch or feelings.  E. सुख, स्पर्श touch.
सुखाधार: सुखाधार m. (-रः) Swarga, the heaven of INDRA, and paradise of the Hindus.  E. सुख pleasure, and आधार a receptacle or reservoir.
सुखानुभव: सुखानुभव m. (-वः) Anticipation or consciousness of pleasure.  E. सुख and अनुभव perception.
सुखान्त: सुखान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Wishing well, friendly, attached. 	 2. Sub-versive of happiness.  E. सुख, अन्त end.
सुखायत: सुखायत m. (-तः) An excellent and well-trained horse.  E. सुख pleasure, आयत restrained.
सुखायन: सुखायन m. (-नः) A good horse.  E. सुख pleasure, and अयन going.
सुखार्थ: सुखार्थ n. Adv. (-र्थं) For the sake of ease, happiness, &c.  E. सुख, and अर्थम् on account of.
सुखार्थिन्: सुखार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking or wishing for happiness.  E. सुख, अर्थिन् seeking.
सुखावतीश्वर: सुखावतीश्वर m. (-रः) A deified teacher of the Bauddhas.
सुखावह: सुखावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Conferring pleasure, delighting, pleasing. E. सुख pleasure, आङ् before वह् to convey, aff. अच् ।
सुखाश: सुखाश m. (-शः) 	 1. VARUṆA, deity of water. 	 2. A cucumber, (Cucumbis sativus.) 	 2. Eating with pleasure, feeding on dainties, &c.  E. सुख pleasure, अश् to eat, अच् aff.
सुखाशक: सुखाशक m. (-कः) The common cucumber.  E. सुखाश the same, कन् added.
सुखासीन: सुखासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Seated or sitting at ease.  E. सुख, आसीन seated.
सुखास्वाद: सुखास्वाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Well-flavoured. 	 2. Delightful, agreeable. m. (-दः) 	 1. Enjoyment. 	 2. A pleasant flavour.  E. सुख, आस्वाद taste.
सुखाहर: सुखाहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Conferring pleasure, agreeable, delightful. E. सुख and आङ् before हृ to take, अच् aff.
सुखिन्: सुखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Happy, pleasant, possessing happiness or pleasure. 	 m. (-खी) A yati or religious ascetic.  E. सुख pleasure, इनि poss. aff.
सुखिस्वभाव: सुखिस्वभाव m. (-वः) A happy or contented disposition.  E. सुखिन्, and स्वभाव nature.
सुखेच्छा: सुखेच्छा f. (-च्छा) Hope or desire of happiness.  E. सुख, and इच्छा wish.
सुखैषिन्: सुखैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wishing well to, seeking another's happiness. E. सुख, and एषिन् who wishes.
सुखोत्सव: सुखोत्सव m. (-वः) 	 1. Pleasure-festival, jubilee. 	 2. A husband.  E. सुख pleasure, उत्सव a festival.
सुखोदय: सुखोदय m. (-यः) Realization or occurence of pleasure.  E. सुख, उदय arising.
सुखोदर्क: सुखोदर्क mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं) Yielding or leading to happiness or pleasure. E. सुख, and उदर्क consequence.
सुखोद्य: सुखोद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be uttered easily or agreeably.  E. सुख, उद्य to be spoken.
सुखोपविष्ट: सुखोपविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seated comfortably or at ease.  E. सुख, and उपविष्ट seated.
सुखोपसर्प्य: सुखोपसर्प्य mfn. (-र्प्यः-र्प्या-र्प्यं) Easy of access.  E. सुख, and उपसर्प्य to be approached.
सुख्यात: सुख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Celebrated, famous.  E. सु, and ख्यात renowned.
सुख्याति: सुख्याति f. (-तिः) Fame, celebrity.  E. सु, and ख्याति fame.

सुगणित: सुगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Easily or accurately calculated.  E. स, and गणित counted.

सुवर्च्चक: सुवर्च्चक mf. (-कः-र्च्चका or र्च्चिका) Natron,  E. सु well, वर्च्च् to shine, aff. ण्वुल् ।

सुवर्णकर्त्तृ: सुवर्णकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A goldsmith.  E. सवर्ण, and कर्त्तृ who makes.

सुविनीत: सुविनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well trained, properly behaved. 	 f. (-ता) A tractable cow.  E. सु exceeding, and विनात well-behaved.
सुविलय: सुविलय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Easily fusible, liquefying.  E. सु and वि before ली to melt, अच् aff.
सुविश्वस्त: सुविश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusty, confidential.  E. सु, and विश्वस्त trusted in.
सुविस्तर: सुविस्तर n. Adv. (-रं) Fully, at length.  E. सु, and विस्तर expansion.

सुविहित: सुविहित f. (-ता) Adj. 	 1. Well-placed. 	 2. Well-furnished, well-supplied. 3. Well-done.
सुवीज: सुवीज f. (-जा) Adj. Having good seed. 	 m. (-जः) The poppy. 	 n. (-जं) Good seed.
सुवीरक: सुवीरक n. (-कं) A collyrium, prepared from the Amomum anthorhizon. E. सु well, वीर power, efficacy, and कन् added, or ण्वुल् aff.
सुवीराम्ल: सुवीराम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sour rice-gruel.  E. सु very, वीर essence, अम्ल sour.
सुवीर्य: सुवीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Great vigour. 	 2. The fruit of the jujube. 	 f. (-र्य्या) Wild-cotton.  E. सु good, and वीर्य्य essence.
सुवीर्य्य: सुवीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Great vigour. 	 2. The fruit of the jujube. 	 f. (-र्य्या) Wild-cotton.  E. सु good, and वीर्य्य essence.
सुवृत्त: सुवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 	 1. Virtuous, good. 	 2. Well or handsomely round. 	 m. (-त्तः) A kind of esculent root. 	 f. (-त्ता) Grape.  E. सु, and वृत्त practised, &c.
सुवेल: सुवेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Bowed, bent, stooping. 	 2. Tamed, humble, quiet. 	 m. (-लः) A mountain; also called Trikuta.  E. सु well, and वेल् to move or shake, aff. अच् ।
सुवेश: सुवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Well-dressed.  E. सु, and वेश attire; also सुवेष.
सुवेषिन्: सुवेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Well-dressed, ornamented, decorated.  E. सु, excellent, वेश ornament, decoration, इनि poss. aff.
सुव्यक्त: सुव्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Plain, manifest. 	 n. Adv. (-क्तं) Evidently, clearly. E. सु, and व्यक्त manifested.
सुव्यस्त: सुव्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Dispersed.  E. सु, and व्यस्त scattered.
सुव्रत: सुव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Virtuous, strict, rigidly observing any religious vow or obligation. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. The twentieth Jina of the present age; also named Munisuvrata. 	 2. One of the Jainas of the future era. 	 3. The religious student. 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. The mother of the fifteenth Jaina of the present age. 	 2. A cow easily milked, one of a trac-table and gentle disposition. 	 3. A virtuous wife.  E. सु well, good, व्रत a vow.
सुशंस: सुशंस f. (-सा) Adj. Well-spoken, praiseworthy, glorious.
सुशक: सुशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Easily made or done.  E. सु, and शक able.
सुशर्मन्: सुशर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Exquisitely happy. 	 m. (-र्म्मा) The name of a prince.  E. सु exceeding, शर्म्मन् pleasure.
सुशर्म्मन्: सुशर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Exquisitely happy. 	 m. (-र्म्मा) The name of a prince.  E. सु exceeding, शर्म्मन् pleasure.
सुशवी: सुशवी f. (-वी) 	 1. A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) “कारवेल्ल”. 	 2. A sort of a spice, (Nigella Indica.) “कृष्णजीरक”.  E. सु well, शव् to go, affs. अच् and ङीष्; also सुषवी, सुसवी, &c.
सुशासित: सुशासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-governed.  E. सु and शासित governed.
सुशिख: सुशिख m. (-खः) AGNI or fire. 	 f. (-खा) 	 1. A peacock's crest. 	 2. A cock's comb.  E. सु handsome, and शिखा a crest.
सुशिरस्: सुशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Having a fine head.  E. सु, and शिरस् head.
सुशीत: सुशीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very cold or cooling. 	 n. (-तं) A yellow fragrant sort of Sandal-wood.  E. सु very, शीत cold.
सुशीतल: सुशीतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very cold or cooling, frigid, freezing. 	 n. (-लं) A fragrant sort of grass; also कुत्तृण.  E. सु very, शीतल cold.
सुशीम: सुशीम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Cold, frigid. 	 m. (-मः) Cold, coldness.  E. सु much, श्यै to go, aff. मक; more usually read सुषीम ।
सुशील: सुशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Well-disposed, of good temper or disposition. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. The wife of YAMA. 	 2. Name of one of KRISHNA'S eight favourite wives.  E. सु well, and शील nature.
सुशीलता: सुशीलता f. (-ता) Natural amiability, excellence of temper or disposition. E. तल् added to the last; also सुशीलत्व n. (-त्वं)
सुशीविका: सुशीविका f. (-का) A sort of yam.
सुश्रुत: सुश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Well-heard. 	 2. Versed in the Vedas. 	 m. (-तः) Name of the author of a system of medicine, and son of VISHWĀ-MITRA. His work, named after him, together with that of CHARAKA, is regarded as the oldest medical authority in India.  E. सु well, श्रुत heard.
सुश्लिष्ट: सुश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्ठं) 	 1. Closely united or adhering to. 	 2. Well fitted.  E. सु, श्लिष्ट united.
सुश्लेष: सुश्लेष m. (-षः) 	 1. Close or intimate union. 	 2. A close embrace.  E. सु, and श्लेष embrace.
सुषम: सुषम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Beautiful, handsome, pleasing. 	 2. Same, even, all. 	 f. (-मा) 	 1. Exquisite beauty. 	 2. Great refulgence. 	 3. A period of time peculiar to the Jainas, the second division of a large period, containing six such portions, and that in which steady happiness is enjoyed by mankind: (the word however more usually occurs written सुखमा, as derived from सुख pleasure.)  E. सु handsome, सम even, all, and the स changed after this particle.
सुषवी: सुषवी f. (-वी) 	 1. A sort of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) 	 2. Black cumin-seed, generally confounded with Kalonji, (Nigella Indica.) 3. Cumin-seed.  E. सु well, षु to send or direct, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ङीष्; also सुशवी, &c.
सुषामन्: सुषामन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Sweetly or kindly spoken.  E. सु, सामन् calming.
सुषि: सुषि f. (-षिः) 	 1. A hole. 	 2. Drying. 	 3. A tube or pipe.  E. शुष्-इन्-पृषो०: स substituted for श; see शुषिर ।
सुषिर: सुषिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Perforated, pierced. 	 2. Having apertures or holes. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A hole, an opening. 	 2. A wind-instrument. 	 f. (-रा) Nalukā, a perfume. 	 m. (-रः) Fire.  E. स substituted for श: see शुषिर ।
सुषीम: सुषीम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Cold, frigid. 	 2. Pleasant, agreeable. 	 m. (-मः) 1. Cold. 	 2. A sort of snake. 	 3. The moon-gem.  E. सु well, सीमा a limit; also read सुषिम and सुशीम ।
सुषुप्त: सुषुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Fast asleep.  E. सु well, ष्वप् to sleep, aff. क्त ।
सुषिप्ति: सुषिप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 	 1. Deep sleep, profound repose, entire insensibility. 	 2. Spiritual ignorance.  E. सु well, ष्वप् to sleep, क्तिन् aff.
सुषुप्सु: सुषुप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Wishing to sleep.  E. ष्वप् to sleep, desid, v., उ aff.
सुषुम्णा: सुषुम्णा f. (-म्णा) A particular artery of the body lying between the vessels called IDĀ and PINGALĀ.
सुषेण: सुषेण m. (-णः) 	 1. A fruit, (Carissa Carondas) “करम्चा” 2. VISHṆU. 	 3. The physician of the monkey chief SUGRĪVA. 	 4. A cane or reed, the ratan. 	 f. (-णी) A plant, commonly Teori, (Convolvolus turpethum.) E. सु excellent, सेना a host or cluster.
सुषेणिका: सुषेणिका f. (-का) Black Teori, (Convolvulus turpethum.)  E. कन् added to the last.
सुष्ठु: सुष्ठु Ind. 	 1. Much, very much. 	 2. Well, excellently. 	 3. Truly.  E. सु well, स्था to stay, aff. कु ।
सुश्म: सुश्म n. (-श्मं) A rope, a cord.  E. सु-मक्-सुक् च ।
सुसङ्गृहीत: सुसंगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Well-kept or preserved. 	 2. Well-abridged.  E. सु, संगृहीत taken.
सुसंगृहीत: सुसंगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Well-kept or preserved. 	 2. Well-abridged.  E. सु, संगृहीत taken.
सुसंस्कृत: सुसंस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Dressed, seasoned, prepared with condi-ments, sauces, &c. 	 2. Entirely perfected, very highly finished, &c.  E. सु well, संकृत made perfect.
सुसंस्थित: सुसंस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Well-situated or placed. 	 2. Being or doing well. 	 3. Circumscribed, well-defined.  E. सु and सम् before स्था to stay, aff. क्त ।
सुसहत: सुसहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-compacted or united, well-kuit.  E. सु, and संहत collected.
सुसन्नत: सुसन्नत f. (-ता) Adj. Well-directed, (as an arrow.)
सुसवी: सुसवी f. (-वी) A sort of pungent seed, either a black species of cumin-seed or the Nigella Indica: see सुषवी ।
सुसम्पद्: सुसम्पद् f. (-म्पद्-म्पत्) Fortune, prosperity.  E. सु good, सम्पद् prosperity.
सुसह: सुसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Easily borne or suffered. 	 2. Bearing or enduring well.  E. सु well, and सह suffering.
सुसार: सुसार m. (-रः) 	 1. The red sort of Khayer, (Mimosa catechu.) 	 2. Good essence or substance. 	 3. Competence.  E. सु good, सार essence.
सुसारवत्: सुसारवत् n. (-वत्) Crystal.  E. सु excellent, सार essence, मतुप् aff.
सुसीमा: सुसीमा f. (-मा) The mother of the sixth Jaina teacher.
सुसेवित: सुसेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Assiduously served or attended upon 2. Much addicted to.  E. सु and सेवित served.
सुस्थ: सुस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 	 1. Well, healthy. 	 2. Happy, faring or living well.  E. सु well, and स्थ being.
सुस्थता: सुस्थता f. (-ता) 	 1. Health. 	 2. Welfare, happiness.  E. सुस्थ being well, तल aff. of condition.
सुस्थयत्: सुस्थयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Setting at rest, appeasing, consoling. E. सुस्थ being well, used as a verb, शतृ aff.
सुस्थित: सुस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Living well or happily. 	 2. Being well, in health or condition.  E. सु, and स्थित who or what stays in.
सुस्थिति: सुस्थिति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Well-being, welfare. 	 2. Health, convalescence.  E. सु, and स्थिति staying.
सुस्थिर: सुस्थिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Firm, steady, stable. 	 2. Resolute. 	 3. Cool.  E. सु well, स्थिर steady.
सुस्ना: सुस्ना m. (-स्ना) A sort of pease. “खेंँसारी”.  E. सु + स्नै-क्विप् aff.
सुस्नात: सुस्नात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-bathed. 	 m. (-तः) A student, who has performed his ablutions preparatory or subsequent to a sacrifice. E. सु auspiciously, स्नात bathed.
सुस्मित: सुस्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smiling. 	 f. (-ता) A woman with a pleasing or smiling countenance.  E. सु well, pleasant, and स्मित smiling.
सुस्मूर्षमाण: सुस्मूर्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wishing or trying to recollect.  E. स्मृ to remember, desid. v., शानच् aff.
सुस्वप्न: सुस्वप्न n. (-प्नं) A lucky or good dream.  E. सु, and स्वप्न a dream.
सुहसानन: सुहसानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having a cheerful or smiling face.  E. सु, हस् laughing, आनन face.
सुहस्ति: सुहस्ति m. (-स्तिः) One of the ten persons called Purbadharas by the Jainas.
सुहित: सुहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Satiated, satisfied. 	 2. Fit, right, suitable. 	 3. Kindly, friendly. 	 4. Salutary, beneficial. 	 f. (-ता) One of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire.  E. सु well, हित placed, &c.
सुहृत्तम: सुहृत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Friendly, cordial, kind.  E. सुहृत् a friend, तमप् aff.
सुहृत्ता: सुहृत्ता f. (-त्ता) Friendship, affection.  E. सुहृत्, and तल् aff.; also सुहृत्व ।
सुहृद्: सुहृद् m. (-हृद् or हृत्) 	 1. A friend. 	 2. An ally.  E. सु good, kind, हृद् heart.
सुहृदय: सुहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Good hearted.  E. सु excellent, हृदय the heart.
सुहृद्बल: सुहृद्बल n. (-लं) The army of an ally.  E. सुहृद्, बल an army.
सुहृद्भेद: सुहृद्भेद m. (-दः) The separation of friends.  E. सुहृद्, and भेद division.
सू: सू f. (-सूः) 	 1. Sending ordering, dispatching. 	 2. Bearing, parturition. 3. Birth. 	 4. A mother.  E. षू to bear or send, aff. क्विप् ।
सूक: सूक n. (-कं) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. A lotus.  E. षू to bring forth, क्विप् affix, and कन् added.
सूक्त: सूक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Well or properly said. 	 n. (-क्तं) 	 1. A hymn in the Rig-Veda. 	 2. A good or wise saying. 	 f. (-क्ता) The Shārika or Mainā.  E. सु well, उक्त spoken, (by which.)
सुक्ति: सुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Friendly speech. 	 2. Correct exposition.
सूक्षण: सूक्षण n. (-णं) Disrespect.  E. सूर्क्ष् to disrespect, aff. ल्युट्; the र rejected; also सूर्क्षण ।
सूक्ष्म: सूक्ष्म mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं) 	 1. Little, small. 	 2. Minute, atomic. 	 3. Fine, delicate. 	 4. Ingenious, subtle. 	 5. Sharp, acute. 	 6. Crafty, artful. 	 7. Exact, precise, accurate. 	 8. Deteriorated, declined. m. (-क्ष्मः) 	 1. An atom. 	 2. Clearing-nut plant, (Strychnos pota-torum.) 	 n. (-क्ष्मं) 	 1. The Supreme Soul, the subtle and invisible spirit that pervades all existence. 	 2. Fraud, cheating. 	 3. Fine thread, &c. 	 4. A figure of rhetoric, the delicate or subtle expression of act or intention. 	 5. Subtlety, ingenuity, craft. 	 6. Minuteness. 	 7. One of the three kinds of power attainable by an ascetic. 	 f. (-क्ष्मा) 	 1. A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 	 2. Small cardamoms. 	 3. A perfume, consisting of a substance in small grains: see Elabāluka.  E. सूच् to inform or make known, मन् Unādi aff., सुक् च नेट् ।
सूक्ष्मतण्डुल: सूक्ष्मतण्डुल m. (-लः) The poppy. “खस्खस्”. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. Long-pepper. 	 2. A sort of grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)  E. सूक्ष्म fine, तण्डुल grain.
सूक्ष्मत्व: सूक्ष्मत्व n. (-त्वं) Fineness, subtilty.  E. सूक्ष्म, त्व aff.; also with तल्, सूक्ष्मता ।
सूक्ष्मदर्शिन्: सूक्ष्मदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) 	 1. Acute, quick, sharp-sighted, intelligent. 2. Acute discernment.  E. सूक्ष्म small, fine, and दर्शिन् who sees.
सूक्ष्मदारु: सूक्ष्मदारु m. (-रुः) A thin plank of wood.  E. सूक्ष्म fine, small, दारु wood.
सूक्ष्मपत्र: सूक्ष्मपत्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. Coriander-seed. 	 2. A wild-kind of cumin. 	 3. A sort of mustard. 	 4. A red sort of sugar-cane. 	 5. The gum Arabic tree, (Mimosa Arabica.)  E. सूक्ष्म fine, small, and पत्र a leaf.
सूक्ष्मपर्णी: सूक्ष्मपर्णी f. (-र्णी) Rāmadūti, a kind of basil.  E. सूक्ष्म small, पर्ण a leaf.
सूक्ष्मबुद्धि: सूक्ष्मबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) 	 1. Sharp, shrewd, intelligent, acute. 	 f. (-द्धिः) Mental acumen.  E. सूक्ष्म and बुद्धि understanding.
सूक्ष्ममक्षिका: सूक्ष्ममक्षिका f. (-का) A musquito, a gnat.  E. सूक्ष्म small, मक्षिका a fly.
सूक्ष्ममान: सूक्ष्ममान n. (-न) Exact measurement, precise computation, as opposed to स्थूलमान or rough calculation.
सूक्षमवस्त्र: सूक्षमवस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Fine cloth.  E. सूक्ष्म fine, वस्त्र cloth.
सूक्ष्मशरीर: सूक्ष्मशरीर n. (-रं) The subtle body invested by and the archetype of the grosser and perceptible frame.  E. सूक्ष्म, and शरीर body.
सूक्ष्मशालि: सूक्ष्मशालि m. (-लिः) A small and fine kind of rice.  E. सूक्ष्म small and शालि rice.
सूक्ष्मषट्चरण: सूक्ष्मषट्चरण m. (-णः) A sort of tick or louse breeding at the roots of the eye-lashes.  E. सूक्ष्म small, and षट्चरण an insect.
सूक्ष्मीकृत: सूक्ष्मीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made thin or minute.  E. सूक्ष्म, कृत made, च्वि aug.

स्त्रीधन: स्त्रीधन n. (-नं) Woman's separate property, which is held to be of six kinds; viz:--1. Adhyagnikam, what is given before the sacrificial fire; 2. Adhyavahanikam, what is presented during the bridal pro-cession; 3. Adhivedanikam, what is given on her husband's marrying another wife; 4. Pritidattam, what is given through affection; 5. Sulkam, her dower allowed or perquisites made during marriage; 6. Anwādheyam, a gift from her own or husband's relatives after marriage. Other varieties are enumera-ted, as the pitri, mātri, suta, bhrātridattam, what is given by her parents, son, or brother; bandhudattam, what is given by her kindred; and some enumerate acceptance generally, and in-heritance, amongst a woman's titles to property. स्वभावदौर्जन्य: स्वभावदौर्जन्य n. (-न्यं) Natural or innate wickedness.  E. स्वभाव, and दौर्जन badness.
स्वभावद्वेष: स्वभावद्वेष m. (-षः) Natural or inherent enmity.  E. स्वभाव, and द्वेष hate.
स्वभावोक्त: स्वभावोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Uttered or declared naturally or spontane-ously.  E. स्वभाव, and उक्त said.
स्वभावोक्ति: स्वभावोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Spontaneous declaration. 	 2. Description of living objects by circumstances or acts suited to their character, (in rhetoric.)  E. स्वभाव, and उक्ति saying.
स्वभू: स्वभू m. (-भूः) 	 1. VISHṆU. 	 2. BRAHMĀ. 	 3. ŚIVA. 	 4. KĀMA.  E. स्व self, भु born.
स्वभूमि: स्वभूमि f. (-मिः) 	 1. Own land or estate. 	 2. Native country.  E. स्व, भूमि land.
स्वयंग्रह: स्वयंग्रह m. (-हः) The taking for one's self, (without leave.)
स्वयंवर: स्वयंवर m. (-रः) The public choice of a husband by a princess, from a number of suitors assembled for the purpose. 	 f. (-रा) A girl choosing her husband.  E. स्वयम् of herself, वर selecting.
स्वयंशीर्ण: स्वयंशीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Fallen or dropped spontaneously.  E. स्वयम्, and शीर्ण decayed.
स्वयङ्कुत: स्वयङ्कुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Self-formed, natural, spontaneous. 	 2. Done to one's self. 	 3. Done by or for one's self.  E. स्वयम् self, कृत made.
स्वयङ्गुप्ता: स्वयङ्गुप्ता f. (-प्ता) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)  E. स्वयम् self, गुप्त preserved.
स्वयन्दत्त: स्वयन्दत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Self-given. 	 m. (-त्तः) A child who has given himself to adoptive parents.  E. स्वयम् self, and दत्त given.

स्वयमुक्ति: स्वयमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Voluntary declaration. 	 2. (In law,) Information, deposition.  E. स्वयम्, उक्ति saying.
स्वयम्प्रभ: स्वयम्प्रभ m. (-भः) A Jaina of the future era.  E. स्वयम् self, प्रभ illustrious.
स्वयम्भु: स्वयम्भु m. (-म्भुः) BRAHMĀ.  E. स्वयम् + भू-डु aff.: see स्वयम्भू ।
स्वयम्भुव: स्वयम्भुव m. (-वः) 	 1. The first MANU. 	 2. BRAHMĀ. 	 3. Śiva.  E. स्वयम् self, भू to be or exist, aff. क; or स्वयम्भ BRAHMĀ, and अण् pleonasm or patronymic aff.
स्वयम्भू: स्वयम्भू m. (-म्भूः) 	 1. BRAHMĀ. 	 2. A Jina or Jaina deified sage. 	 3. An emperor of the world according to the Jainas. 	 4. KĀLA, the deity presiding over time. 	 5. VISHṆU. 	 6. ŚIVA. 	 7. The god of love. 	 8. The female breast.  E. स्वयम् self, भू to exist, क्विप् aff., the self-existent; also read with a short final स्वयम्भु m. (-म्भुः).
स्वयोनि: स्वयोनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Of kin, related by the mother's side. 	 mf. (-निः-निः) Own womb, one's own place of birth. 	 f. (-निः) A sister or near female relative.  E. स्व, योनि place of birth.
स्वर्: स्वर् r. 10th cl. (स्वरयति-ते) 	 1. To blame, to censure, to reprove. 	 2. To sound. (Ind. (Aptote noun.) 	 1. Heaven, paradise, the residence of INDRA and the celestials, (considered as the temporary abode of the virtuous after death.) 	 2. Sky, ether. 	 3. Splendour, beauty. 	 4. One of the divisions of the universe, the space between the sun and the polar star and region of the planets and constellations; in this sense, this word is one of the three mystical words, to be repeated daily at the morning ceremonies, &c., with the holy Gāyatri. E. स्वृ to sound, to be in pain, विच् aff., and the vowel changed.
स्वर: स्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. A Vedic accent, (of which there are three, viz: --उदात, अनुदात्त and स्वरित.) 	 2. A vowel. 	 3. A note of the musical scale or gamut. 	 4. Air breathed through the nostrils. 	 5. Snoring. 	 6. Voice. 7. Sound in general. 	 8. A symbolical expression for the number “seven.”  E. स्वर् to sound, अच् aff.; or स्वृ to sound, अप् aff.
स्वरग्राम: स्वरग्राम m. (-मः) The musical scale, gamut.
स्वरपत्तन: स्वरपत्तन n. (-नं) The Sāma-Veda.  E. स्वर an accent, पत्तन a city: this Veda is chanted according to a peculiar rhythm, and the efficacy of its prayers depends chiefly on their accurate accentuation.
स्वरबद्ध: स्वरबद्ध Adj. Composed in musical measure, adapted to musical time.
स्वरभक्ति: स्वरभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A vowel-sound phonetically inserted in the pronun-ciation of र् or ल् when these latters are followed by a sibilant, (as वर्ष pronounced as वरिष).
स्वरभङ्ग: स्वरभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Fluttering of the voice, &c., as indicative of agitation or feeling.  E. स्वर a sound or note, भङ्ग a breaking.
स्वरभङ्गिन्: स्वरभङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A kind of bird.  E. स्वर a note, भङ्गिन् who breaks or divides.
स्वरमण्डलिका: स्वरमण्डलिका f. (-का) A kind of stringed musical instrument.  E. स्वर a note of a gamut, मण्डल a region, कन् aff., fem. form.
स्वरलासिका: स्वरलासिका f. (-का) A flute, a pipe.  E. स्वर a note, लस् to be skilled, ण्वुल् aff.
स्वरशून्य: स्वरशून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Unmelodious, unmusical.  E. स्वर, शून्य devoid of.
स्वरसंयोग: स्वरसंयोग m. (-गः) 	 1. The junction of vowels. 	 2. Intonation, voice.
स्वरस: स्वरस m. (-सः) 	 1. Expressed or extracted juice. 	 2. Sediment of oil, &c., ground on a stone. 	 3. Proper or peculiar flavour. 	 4. Proper or peculiar taste or sentiment in composition.  E. स्व own, रस flavour, &c.
स्वरसङ्क्रम: स्वरसङ्क्रम m. (-मः) A transition or succession of notes.
स्वरसन्धि: स्वरसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) The junction or coalition of vowels.
स्वरांश: स्वरांश m. (-शः) A half or quarter tone in music.  E. स्वर a note, अंश a part.

स्वरान्तर: स्वरान्तर n. (-रं) The interval between two vowels, hiatus.
स्वरापगा: स्वरापगा f. (-गा) The Ganges.  E. स्वर् heaven, आपगा river.
स्वरारूढ: स्वरारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Ascended to heaven.  E. स्वर्, and आरूढ ascended.
स्वराष्ट्र: स्वराष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रं) Own country or principality.  E. स्व, and राष्ट्र country.

स्वरु: स्वरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. INDRA'S thunderbolt. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. A sacrifice. 	 4. Shavings of the wood of which a sacrificial post is made. 	 5. Sun-shine. 	 6. A kind of scorpion.  E. स्वृ to sound, Unādi aff. उ; also with उसि aff., स्वरुस् ।
स्वरुचि: स्वरुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Wilful, self-willed, uncontrolled.  E. स्व own, रुचि inclination.
स्वरुस्: स्वरुस् m. (-रुः) INDRA'S thunderbolt, &c.: see स्वरु ।
स्वरूप: स्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पा or -पी-पं) 	 1. Wise, learned. 	 2. Pleasing, handsome. 	 3. Similar, like. 	 4. Of like purport or character. 	 n. (-पं) 	 1. Natural state or condition, nature. 	 2. Natural and obvious purpose or conclusion. 	 3. True constitution, natural character. 	 4. One's own form or shape. 	 5. Peculiar aim. 	 6. Kind, sort.  E. स्व own, रूप form.
स्वरूपगत: स्वरूपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having a like object or character.  E. स्वरूप and गत obtained.
स्वरूपता: स्वरूपता f. (-ता) 	 1. Natural state. 	 2. Handsomeness. 	 3. Identity.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, स्वरूपत्वं ।
स्वरूपासिद्धि: स्वरूपासिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) A form of fallacious proof, (in Nyāya phil.)
स्वरेणु: स्वरेणु f. (-णुः) One of the wives of the sun.
स्वर्ग: स्वर्ग m. (-र्गः) Heaven, INDRA'S paradise, and the residence of deified mortals and the inferior gods.  E. मु happiness, ऋज् to go, or obtain, aff. घञ् ।
स्वर्गगत: स्वर्गगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone to heaven.  E. स्वर्ग, and मत gone.
स्वर्गगमन: स्वर्गगमन n. (-नं) Going to heaven.  E. स्वर्ग, गमन going.
स्वर्गगामिन्: स्वर्गगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what goes to heaven.  E. रुवर्ग, गमिन् who goes.
स्वर्गङ्गा: स्वर्गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Ganges of heaven.  E. स्वर् heaven, गङ्गा the Ganges.
स्वर्गजित्: स्वर्गजित् mfn. (-जित्) Obtaining or ensuring paradise.  E. स्वर्ग heaven, and जित् what conquers.
स्वर्गत: स्वर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone to heaven. 	 2. Dead.  E. स्वर्, and गत gone.
स्वर्गात: स्वर्गात f. (-तिः) 	 1. Going to heaven, future felicity. 	 2. Death.  E. स्वर् and गति going; also similar compounds, as स्वर्गमन, &c.
स्वर्गद्वार: स्वर्गद्वार n. (-र) Heaven's gate, entrance into heaven.
स्वर्गपति: स्वर्गपति m. (-तिः) INDRA.  E. स्वर्ग paradise, पति lord.
स्वर्गपर: स्वर्गपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Desirous of INDRA'S heaven.  E. स्वर्ग, पर intent on.
स्वर्गबधू: स्वर्गबधू f. (-धूः) An Apsaras, a nymph or courtezan of INDRA'S heaven. E. स्वर्ग paradise, and बधू woman or wife.
स्वर्गभर्तृ: स्वर्गभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) INDRA.  E. स्वर्ग, and भर्त्त sovereign.
स्वर्गभर्त्तृ: स्वर्गभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) INDRA.  E. स्वर्ग, and भर्त्त sovereign.
स्वर्गलाक: स्वर्गलाक m. (-कः) Paradise, the celestial region.  E. स्वर्ग, लोक world.
स्वर्गलाकेश: स्वर्गलाकेश m. (-शः) INDRA.  E. स्वर्गलोक, and ईश lord; the paradise of INDRA, being appropriated to corporeal felicity.
स्वर्गापगा: स्वर्गापगा f. (-गा) The celestial Ganges.  E. स्वर्ग heaven, and आपगा a river.
स्वर्गारोहण: स्वर्गारोहण n. (-णं) Ascending to heaven.  E. स्वर्ग, and आरोहण going.
स्वर्गारूढ: स्वर्गारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Gone to heaven.  E. स्वर्ग, and आरूढ ascended.
स्वर्गिगिरि: स्वर्गिगिरि m. (-रिः) Mount SUMERU.  E. स्वर्गि a god, गिरि a mountain.
स्वर्गिन्: स्वर्गिन् m. (-र्गा) 	 1. A god, a celestial. 	 2. (In law,) Dead.  E. स्वर्ग, इनि aff.
स्वर्गिबधू: स्वर्गिबधू f. (-धूः) A nymph of paradise.  E. स्वगि a celestial, and बधू wife.
स्वर्गिरि: स्वर्गिरि m. (-रिः) Mount SUMERU.  E. स्वर् heaven, and गिरि a mountain.
स्वर्गीय: स्वर्गीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Heavenly, divine, relating to Swarga.  E. स्वर्ग, छ aff.
स्वर्गीकस्: स्वर्गीकस् m. (-काः) A god, a deity.  E. स्वर्ग paradise, and ओकस् abode.
स्वर्ग्य: स्वर्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं) 	 1. Heavenly, paradisiacal. 	 2. Procuring a place in heaven.  E. स्वर्ग heaven, यत् aff.
स्वर्ण: स्वर्ण n. (-र्णं) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. A gold coin.  E. सु excellent, ऋण् to go or be, aff. अच् ।

स्वर्णकृत्: स्वर्णकृत् m. (-कृत्) A goldsmith.  E. स्वर्ण gold, and कृत् who makes.
स्वर्णक्षीरी: स्वर्णक्षीरी f. (-री) A medicinal kind of moon-plant, said to be brought from the Himālaya mountains.  E. स्वर्ण gold, (like or yellow,) क्षीर milk, or milky sap, ङीष् fem. aff.
स्वर्णगैरिक: स्वर्णगैरिक n. (-कं) A kind of ochre, golden ochre.  E. स्वर्ण gold. and गैरिक chalk.
स्वर्णचूड: स्वर्णचूड m. (-डः) 	 1. The blue jay. 	 2. A cock.  E. स्वर्ण gold, चूडा a crest.
स्वर्णज: स्वर्णज n. (-जं) Tin.  E. स्वर्ण gold, ज born.
स्वर्णदी: स्वर्णदी f. (-दी) The Ganges of heaven.  E. स्वर् heaven, नदी a river; the न changed to ण; also स्वर्नदी ।
स्वर्णदीधिति: स्वर्णदीधिति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire.  E. स्वर्ण gold, दीधिति a ray.
स्वर्णद्रु: स्वर्णद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree with yellow blossoms.  E. स्वर्ण gold, and द्रु a tree.
स्वर्णपक्ष: स्वर्णपक्ष m. (-क्षः) GARUḌA.  E. स्वर्ण gold, and पक्ष a wing or feather.
स्वर्णपद्मा: स्वर्णपद्मा f. (-द्मा) The Ganges of heaven.  E. स्वर्ण gold, पद्म lotus; bearing golden lotuses.

स्वर्णबणिज्: स्वर्णबणिज् m. (-णिक्) A particular fallen caste.
स्वर्णमाक्षिक: स्वर्णमाक्षिक n. (-कं) A particular mineral substance.
स्वर्णयूथी: स्वर्णयूथी f. (-थी) Yellow jasmine.  E. स्वर्ण gold, and यूथी jasmine.
स्वर्णरेखा: स्वर्णरेखा f. (-खा) A streak of gold.  E. स्वर्ण, रेखा a line; also स्वर्णलेखा ।
स्वर्णवर्णा: स्वर्णवर्णा f. (-र्णा) Turmeric.  E. स्वर्ण gold, वर्ण colour.
स्वर्णबल्कल: स्वर्णबल्कल m. (-लः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)  E. स्वर्ण gold, वल्कल bark.
स्वर्णविन्दु: स्वर्णविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 	 1. A spot of yellow or gold. 	 2. VISHṆU.  E. स्वर्ण gold, and विन्दु a spot.
स्वर्णशीफालिका: स्वर्णशीफालिका f. (-का) A tree, (Cassia fistula.)  E. स्वर्ण gold, and शेफालिका Nyctanthes.
स्वर्णारि: स्वर्णारि m. (-रिः) Sulphur.  E. स्वर्ण gold, and अरि hostile.
स्वर्त्: स्वर्त्त् r. 10th cl. (स्वर्त्तयति-ते) 	 1. To be miserable or distrest. 	 2. To go.
स्वर्त्त्: स्वर्त्त् r. 10th cl. (स्वर्त्तयति-ते) 	 1. To be miserable or distrest. 	 2. To go.
स्वर्द्: स्वर्द्द् r. 1st cl. (स्वर्द्दते) 	 1. To taste. 	 2. To be pleasing.
स्वर्द्द्: स्वर्द्द् r. 1st cl. (स्वर्द्दते) 	 1. To taste. 	 2. To be pleasing.
स्वर्नदी: स्वर्नदी f. (-दी) The Ganges of heaven.  E. स्वर् heaven, and नदी a river, and the न unchanged; also स्वर्णदी ।
स्वर्बधू: स्वर्बधू f. (-धूः) An Apsaras.  E. स्वर् heaven, and बधू wife.
स्वर्भानव: स्वर्भानव m. (-वः) A kind of precious stone, called GOMEDHA.
स्वर्भानु: स्वर्भानु m. (-नुः) RĀHU, the personified ascending node.  E. स्वर् heaven, भानु shining.

स्वसृ: स्वसृ f. (-सा) A sister.  E. सु before अस् to be or live, Unādi aff. ऋन् ।

A building or place of a peculiar shape, described as surrounded by a terrace, or portico, on the north, west, and south sides, and having the door or entrance on the east. 	 4. E. कन् added to the last.

स्वस्तिमत्: स्वस्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Happy, auspicious.  E. स्वस्ति, and मतुप् aff.

स्वाङ्किक: स्वाङ्किक m. (-कः) 	 1. A drummer. 	 2. A kind of drum.
स्वाच्छन्द्य: स्वाच्छन्द्य n. (-न्द्य) Wilfulness, independence.  E. स्वच्छन्द self-willed, ष्यञ् aff.
स्वातन्त्र्य: स्वातन्त्र्य n. (-न्त्र्यं) Wilfulness, independence.  E. स्वतन्त्र self-willed, ष्यञ् aff.

स्वादुकार: स्वादुकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Delicate in taste, dainty.  E. स्वादु, कार who acts.

स्वामिकार्य्य: स्वामिकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) The business of a prince or master.  E. स्वामिन्, कार्य्य affair.
स्वामिता: स्वामिता f. (-ता) 	 1. Ownership. 	 2. Sovereignty.  E. स्वामिन्, तल् aff.; also with त्व, स्वामित्वं ।

स्वास्थ्य: स्वास्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) 	 1. Health. 	 2. Content, happiness, complacency. satisfac-tion. 	 3. Fortitude, firmness, self-dependence. 	 4. Prosperity, com-fortableness, competence.  E. स्व self, स्थ who is or stays, ष्यञ् aff.
स्वाहा: स्वाहा Ind. An exclamation uttered at the time of making an offering to the gods, (used with a noun in the dative.) 	 f. (-हा) 	 1. A personi-fication of the preceding, as the wife of fire, and goddess presiding over burnt offerings. 	 2. An oblation made to Gods indiscrimi-nately. 	 3. A female divinity, peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. सु well, auspiciously, आङ् before ह्वेञ् to call, to invoke, (the gods,) and डा aff.; or स्वाद् to taste, aff. आ, and द changed to ह ।
स्वाहाकार: स्वाहाकार m. (-रः) Utterance of the term Swāhā.  E. स्वाहा, कार making.
स्वाहापति: स्वाहापति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire.  E. स्वाहा the goddess, and पति husband.
स्वाहाप्रिय: स्वाहाप्रिय m. (-यः) AGNI or fire.  E. स्वाहा the goddess, and प्रिय beloved.
स्वाहाभुज्: स्वाहाभुज् m. (-भुक्) A deity.  E. स्वाहा the oblation, and भुज् who eats.
स्वित्: स्वित् Ind. 	 1. A particle of questioning, (hey, what ?) 	 2. An exclama-tion of doubt or surprise. 	 3. An expletive. It is added to interro-gative pronouns and adverbs to impart to them the sense of indefiniteness; (used generally after आहो or किम्, &c., and is trans-latable by “whether.”)  E. सु well, इण् to go, aff. क्विप् ।
स्विदित: स्विदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sweated, melted. 	 2. Sweating, perspiring. E. ष्विद् to be unctuous, aff. क्त ।
स्विन्न: स्विन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Sweating, perspiring.  E. ष्विद् to perspire, क्त aff.
स्वीकरण: स्वीकरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Assenting, agreeing. 	 2. Promising. 	 3. Marriage, wedding.  E. स्व own, करण making, च्वि augment.
स्वीकरणीय: स्वीकरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be promised. 	 2. To be admitted, con-sented, or agreed to.  E. स्व before कृ to make, अनीयर् aff., च्वि aug-ment; also स्वीकर्त्तव्य and स्वीकृत्य.
स्वीकार: स्वीकार n. (-रं) 	 1. Promise. 	 2. Assent, agreement.  E. स्व own, कार making, च्वि augment.
स्वीकाररहित: स्वीकाररहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not agreed or assented to.  E. स्वीकार, and रहित void. of.
स्वीकारान्त: स्वीकारान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Agreed to, (consequent upon a promise or assent.)  E. स्वीकार, अन्त end.
स्वीकृत: स्वीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Agreed, assented to. 	 2. Promised.  E. स्व, कृत made, च्वि augment.
स्वीकृत्य: स्वीकृत्य Ind. Having agreed or promised.  E. स्व, and कृत्य having made, च्वि augment.
स्वीय: स्वीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Own, relating or belonging to one. 	 f. (-या) A virtu-ous woman, one attached solely to her husband.  E. स्व own, छ aff.
स्वुर्च्छ्: स्वुर्च्छ् r. 1st cl. (स्वुर्च्छति) 	 1. To spread, to extend. 	 2. To forget; also स्फुर्च्छ् ।
स्वृ: स्वृ r. 1st cl. (-स्वरति) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To be diseased. 	 3. To pain or torture. 	 4. To praise. With सम् prefixed, in an intransitive sense, the verb becomes deponent, (संस्वरते) It sounds.
स्वृ r. 9th cl. (स्वृणाति) To hurt, to kill.
स्वेक्: स्वेक् (ऋ,) स्वेकृ r. 1st cl. (स्वेकते) To go, to move.
स्वेच्छा: स्वेच्छा f. (-च्छा) Wilfulness, following one's own, purpose or inclina-tion, self-will.  E. स्व own, इच्छा wish.
स्वेच्छामृत्यु: स्वेच्छामृत्यु m. (-त्युः) BHĪSHMA.  E. स्वेच्छा self-will, मृत्यु death.
स्वेच्छाहार: स्वेच्छाहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Omnivorous, eating anything at pleasure. E. स्वेच्छा and आहार food.
स्वेद: स्वेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Warm, perspiring. 	 m. (-दः) 	 1. Warmth, heat. 	 2. Perspiration, sweat. 	 3. Vapour, steam.  E. ष्विद् to perspire, &c., aff. घञ्, or causal verb, अच् aff.
स्वेदचूषक: स्वेदचूषक m. (-कः) A pleasant and cooling breeze.  E. स्वेद perspiration, चूष् to suck or imbibe, aff. वुन् ।
स्वेदच्छिद्: स्वेदच्छिद् mfn. (-च्छित्) Cooling, allaying perspiration.  E. स्वेद, and छिद् what cuts.
स्वेदज: स्वेदज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Engendered by heat and damp, as insects and worms.  E. स्वेद sweat or vapour, and ज produced.
स्वेदजल: स्वेदजल n. (-लं) Perspiration.  E. स्वेद and जल water.
स्वेदन: स्वेदन n. (-नं) 	 1. Perspiration, sweat. 	 2. Sweating, causing to perspire. 3. A diaphoretic, a sudorific.  E. ष्विद् to be unctuous or sweaty ल्युट् aff.
स्वेदनिका: स्वेदनिका f. (-का) An iron plate or pan used as a cooking utensil. E. स्वेदन sweat, ङीष् aff., and कन् fem. form added.
स्वेदनी: स्वेदनी f. (-नी) An iron plate or pan used as a frying pan, &c.  E. ष्विद् to perspire, ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.
स्वेदमलोञ्झितदेह: स्वेदमलोञ्झितदेह m. (-हः) A holy or sainted teacher of the Jainas. E. स्वेद perspiration, मल excrement, उञ्झित abandoned, and देह body whose body is no longer subject to its original impurities.
स्वेदविन्दु: स्वेदविन्दु f. (-न्दुः) A drop of perspiration.  E. स्वेद, विन्दु a drop.
स्वेदविप्रुष्: स्वेदविप्रुष् f. (-प्रट्) A drop of perspiration.  E. स्वेद sweat, विप्रुष् a drop.
स्वेदोदक: स्वेदोदक n. (-कं) Perspiration.  E. स्वेद and उदक water; also स्वेदोद ।
स्वैर: स्वैर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Self-willed, unrestrained. 	 2. Slow, lazy. 	 3. Voluntary, optional. 	 4. Going. 	 n. (-रं) Following one's own inclination.  E. स्व self, ईर् to go or be, aff. अण् ।
स्वैरता: स्वैरता f. (-ता) Wilfulness, independence.  E. स्वैर self-willed, तल् aff.
स्वैरम्: स्वैरम् Ind. 	 1. Of one's own accord. 	 2. Lowly, indistinctly.
स्वैरवृत्त: स्वैरवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Acting or living as one likes.  E. स्वैर, वृत्त practising.
स्वैरिता: स्वैरिता f. (-ता) Wilfulness.  E. स्वैरिन् self-willed, तल् aff.
सवैरिन्: सवैरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-प्रि) Uncontrolled, self-willed. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. An unchaste wife, an adulteress. 	 2. A wanton woman.  E. स्व self, ईर् to go, णिनि aff.
स्वोदय: स्वोदय m. (-यः) The rising of a sign or heavenly body at any particular place
स्वोपार्जित: स्वोपार्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Self-got, self-acquired, (as wealth, &c.)  E. स्व self, उपार्जित obtained.
स्वोरस: स्वोरस m. (-सः) Sediment of oil, &c., ground with a stone and muller.
स्वोवश्वीय: स्वोवश्वीय n. (-यं) Happiness, prosperity; more preferably श्वोवसीयस ।
